en: Glass Worker
Welcome to my glass workshop! I make glass out of the volcanic ash that falls on the road outside.
But I'm getting on, and gathering ash is hard work. Would you collect some for me? Take this.
Walk through the grass where the ash lies with that Soot Sack in your bag, and the ash will go right into it.
Bring me plenty, and I'll make you something lovely out of it.
Let's have a look at the ash you've gathered. Hmm... {var:VAR_ASH_GATHER_COUNT} steps' worth.
Which shall I make for you?
Blue Flute (250)
Yellow Flute (500)
Red Flute (500)
White Flute (1,000)
Black Flute (1,000)
Nothing
Come back whenever you like. The ash keeps falling!
A Blue Flute it is! There we are, fresh from the fire.
A Yellow Flute it is! There we are, fresh from the fire.
A Red Flute it is! There we are, fresh from the fire.
A White Flute it is! There we are, fresh from the fire.
A Black Flute it is! There we are, fresh from the fire.
Oh dear, that takes more ash than you've gathered. Go and collect a little more.
That's not quite enough to make anything yet. Keep walking through that ash!
Where's the Soot Sack I gave you? I can't make anything without the ash in it.
